control_flow: followInTheDark: if dim, steer by the line tracker (below 90 % curve left, above 90 % curve right, exactly 90 % call avoidWalls); if bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dim, check the left and right obstacle sensors (turn away 20°) else call driveInTheDark; if bright, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dim, drive forward at 30 %; if bright, call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10/40); else curve right (40/10).
